| Line item | Amount |
|---|---|
| GAAP operating loss [DOC-1] | $(44,373) |
| + Stock-based compensation expense [DOC-1] | 750,671 |
| + Amortization of acquired intangibles [DOC-1] | 6,373 |
| + Employer payroll taxes on employee stock transactions [DOC-1] | 53,799 |
| + M&A transaction costs [DOC-1] | 1,574 |
| **= Non-GAAP operating income** | **$768,044** |

Supporting source: "RECONCILIATION OF GAAP TO NON-GAAP OPERATING INCOME (LOSS) (in thousands), Year Ended December 31, 2025: GAAP operating loss: $(44,373); Stock-based compensation expense: $750,671; Amortization of acquired intangibles: $6,373; Employer payroll taxes on employee stock transactions: $53,799; M&A transaction costs: $1,574" [DOC-1].

**Comparability notes:** This is a single-period figure drawn from one reconciliation covering a full twelve-month fiscal year ending December 31, 2025, so no fiscal-year, entity, or segment mismatch applies. Two caveats on the number itself: (1) the excerpt provides the reconciling items but not Datadog's own stated non-GAAP total, so $768,044 thousand is my sum of the disclosed components and assumes the list of adjustments is complete as presented; (2) non-GAAP operating income is not a GAAP measure and excludes recurring costs — most notably $750,671 thousand of stock-based compensation, which is roughly 98% of the total adjustment — so it is not directly comparable to the GAAP operating loss of $(44,373) thousand [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Approximately $768.0 million (i.e., $768,044 thousand) of non-GAAP operating income for FY2025
